name: FIT EASY Inc.
summary: FIT EASY Inc. develops stores and services based on its know-how in amusement fitness clubs, managing and operating them and planning franchise expansion. Its offerings include fit aero, fit golf and fit sauna, as well as fit lounge, fit race, fit baseball, fit ride and a bouldering wall. It dates from 2018 and has its head office in Gifu, Japan.
